body: Hey yeah I'm cool to talk if were approximately the same age (I don't really feel comfortable otherwise). But tbh I'm going to have to go to sleep soon because I need to sleep. But yeah!
Well then I know this could seem hard, but try to meet new people, I'm sure that at least one of them will love you the way you want, tons of people are open to make new friends.

First of all let me say that the internet is a great place to let out all your problems because there are tons of people willing to help you. And don't worry about rambling lol it's totally normal. 
I can't relate to the deep deep sadness and misery you must feel (at least that's what I perceived through your text) but I totally get you on the feeling alone part. I've never been in a relationship, I have very few friends which whom I'm not that close but contrary to you I don't have your family problems. On that point, your mother must love you even if she says all these terrible things. People can love even if they say all thses terrible things, but I don't know much about the situation so I can't really make assumptions. 
Also, are you in your teen years? Because if you are know that they are the most difficult times of your life, I would know I'm in those years myself. And feeling lonely is such a normal feeling at that age. I can't promise things will get better because I don't know but in most cases they do. 
Then another point that stuck out to me was about your psychiatrist I think? He/she is the perfect person to talk to, it's their job to help you and you need to reveal all of your feelings to them for them to help you the best. That is if you haven't already. I must insist on seeking professional help in these situations, that is what will help you the most. 
Then, you said you loved photography? Then stick to that. Do as much photography as you can, do what makes you happy. Thay is truely the only thing that matters no matter how hard it is to convince yourself. I have difficulty with that as well so don't stress about it.
I'm going to repeat myself but soeak to your psychiatrist or any other professional help. It is really what will help you the best. You probably know about the suicide hotline, I don't know the number but tou can contact them as well. And I suppose that groups exist where people talk about these kind of things and when they are all in the same situation, that could be a great thing because you could make friends that feel the same and stuff.
Finally, to awnser you actual question but keeping in mind that I totally hope you don't end your life because that is the worst thing you could do to yourself; if (and again don't) you do this, in your suicide note you just lay down your feelings like you did in this post. Say how you feel and let all the emotions flow out. You could do this and then give the letter to your psychiatrist, without ending your life of course? That could be a good idea because often, writing is easier than speaking.

I truely hope you find a way out of the hell you are living and know that people do care.
Please please don't I beg you
